mentions.name: Terminai
mentions.description: This app is a transparent wrapper for any terminal that provides on-demand access to a TUI coding agent of the user's choice via a hotkey, with built-in MCP and a CLI that gives the AI access to the user's terminal.
mentions.problem: The author was frustrated with choosing between the efficiency of working in a terminal and the power of using AI, and with copy-pasting between the two.
mentions.source_excerpt: Terminai is a transparent wrapper for any terminal that provides on-demand access to a TUI coding agent of your choice just a hotkey away (with built-in MCP and CLI that gives the AI access to your terminal).
mentions.author: emosenkis
